title: Engine response to operation lemmas (/io/response.json)
description: Stage 2 of Critical slices: one entry per declared lemma. pass: the postcondition holds for the engine's search. fail: a counterexample is attached. inconclusive: the engine could not decide within its budget. no_pair: in refactor, the base has no lemma of the same name to diff against. A passing lemma never raises the verdict of its parent function.

counterexample.description: fail: the input and what the lemma returned, as the engine writes them. The core keys on the shapes: {args, returned} or {args, raised} is a broken postcondition (Tier 0 feedback to the builder); {args, old, new} is a refactor divergence, which becomes a probe.

error.description: Set when the engine cannot run the lemmas (a lemma that was not checked is never a PASS).
